# Task P1-06: Identity resolver

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** P1-02, P1-03, P1-04 · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
Given whatever a user types or pastes — `Artist - Title`, free text, a MusicBrainz recording id or URL, an ISRC, a Deezer track id or URL — Compilarr finds the song's identity: the MusicBrainz recording when one exists (with its artists, duration, ISRCs, version flags and every official release it appears on), otherwise the Deezer track, otherwise "unresolved". It also lists ranked candidates for the add-by-search UI. This task is read-only: nothing is written to the song tables (P1-07 does that).

## Deliverables
Namespace `Compilarr.Core.Identity`; register everything in `AddCompilarrMetadata` (transient/singleton, never capturing a scoped service).

1. `src/Compilarr.Core/Identity/TextMatching.cs` — `static string Normalize(string s)`: lower-case invariant, strip diacritics (NFD, drop non-spacing marks), `&` → ` and `, remove `'` and `’`, every other non-letter/non-digit → space, collapse whitespace, trim. `static string NormalizeArtist(string s)`: `Normalize` minus a leading `the `. `static double Similarity(string a, string b)`: token-sort ratio on normalised strings = 1 − Levenshtein(sortedTokensA, sortedTokensB) / max(len) (1.0 for two empty strings).
2. `src/Compilarr.Core/Identity/LookupInput.cs` — `LookupInput.Parse(string raw)` → `sealed record LookupInput(LookupKind Kind, string Raw, string? Artist, string? Title, string? MbRecordingId, string? Isrc, long? DeezerTrackId, string? UnsupportedReason)` with `LookupKind { ArtistTitle, FreeText, MbRecordingId, Isrc, DeezerTrackId, Unsupported }`:
   - a GUID, or `http(s)://(beta.)musicbrainz.org/recording/{guid}[/…]` → `MbRecordingId` (lower-case);
   - an ISRC (`^[A-Za-z]{2}[A-Za-z0-9]{3}\d{7}$` after removing hyphens) → `Isrc` (upper-case);
   - `http(s)://(www.)deezer.com/[xx/]track/{id}` or `deezer:track:{id}` → `DeezerTrackId`;
   - `open.spotify.com`, `spotify:`, `youtube.com`, `youtu.be`, `music.youtube.com`, and any other URL → `Unsupported` with a short reason ("Spotify links are imported through CSV exports (Phase 6)"; "YouTube links arrive with the YouTube source (Phase 4)"; "Unsupported link");
   - text containing ` - `, ` – ` or ` — ` → `ArtistTitle` split at the **first** separator, both parts trimmed (empty part → `FreeText`);
   - anything else non-empty → `FreeText`.
3. `src/Compilarr.Core/Identity/IdentityModels.cs` — records:
   - `IdentityArtist(string Name, string? SortName, string? MbArtistId, long? DeezerArtistId, ArtistRole Role, int Position)`;
   - `SongIdentity { Source ("musicbrainz" | "deezer"); MbRecordingId?; DeezerId?; Title; ArtistCredit; Artists; DurationMs?; Isrcs; Flags (VersionFlags); Disambiguation?; OriginalDate?; ReleaseOptions (IReadOnlyList<ReleaseOption> from P1-05); CoverUrl? (Deezer album cover for Deezer-only identities) }`;
   - `SongCandidate { Source; MbRecordingId?; DeezerId?; Title; ArtistCredit; DurationMs?; Disambiguation?; Flags; FirstReleaseDate?; ReleaseTypes (distinct, e.g. "Album", "Single", "Compilation"); AlbumTitle?; Isrcs; Score (0–100); ViaIsrc (bool) }`;
   - `ResolveResult { Status (Resolved | ResolvedDeezerOnly | Unresolved | Unsupported); Identity?; Candidates (top 5); Reason? }`.
4. `src/Compilarr.Core/Identity/IdentityResolver.cs` — `IIdentityResolver` / `IdentityResolver(IMusicBrainzClient, IDeezerClient, ILogger<IdentityResolver>)`:
   - `Task<ResolveResult> ResolveAsync(string raw, CancellationToken)` — for bulk adds; picks one identity or none.
   - `Task<IReadOnlyList<SongCandidate>> SearchAsync(string raw, int limit, CancellationToken)` — for the UI; ranked candidates (MB and Deezer-only), deduplicated by MBID.
   - `Task<SongIdentity?> GetIdentityAsync(string? mbRecordingId, long? deezerTrackId, CancellationToken)` — the full identity used when adding (exactly one id; the other may accompany it: a Deezer id passed with an MBID is kept as `DeezerId`).
5. Tests: `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Identity/TextMatchingTests.cs`, `LookupInputTests.cs`, and `tests/Compilarr.Sources.Tests/Identity/IdentityResolverTests.cs` using the **real** `MusicBrainzClient` and `DeezerClient` over a fixture-serving stub `HttpMessageHandler` (route table: request path + query, matched case-insensitively after URL-decoding → fixture file; an unmapped MusicBrainz request answers 404 `{"error":"Not Found"}`, an unmapped Deezer request answers 200 with `{"data":[],"total":0}` for searches or the code-800 error body otherwise) and the in-memory cache from P1-02's tests. Inline JSON in the test is fine for synthetic cases.

## Resolution rules
**Scoring a candidate** against the query (0–100): title = `Similarity(query base title, candidate base title)` × 40 (base titles from `VersionFlagParser`, version hints and feat. removed); artist = max `Similarity(NormalizeArtist(query artist), NormalizeArtist(x))` over the candidate's full credit string and each credited artist name, × 30; flags = 15 when the **hard** flags (`VersionFlagNames.HardFlags`) of query and candidate are equal, else 0; duration = 15 when a reference duration is known and both are within 2 s, falling linearly to 0 at 15 s; 7.5 when there is no reference but the candidate has a length; 0 when the candidate has no length; +10 when the candidate came through the ISRC bridge; −20 when MB says `video`; clamp to 0–100. Candidate flags come from `VersionFlagParser.Parse(title, disambiguation)`; the query's from `Parse(query title)`. Ties: earliest `FirstReleaseDate` (nulls last), then MBID ordinal.

**Acceptable** = score ≥ 70, title similarity ≥ 0.85, artist similarity ≥ 0.80 and equal hard flags.

**`ArtistTitle` / `FreeText`:**
1. Deezer `SearchTracksAsync("{artist} {title}")` (free text: the raw text), limit 25. The **reference hit** is the first hit (Deezer order) that is acceptable against the query by the same similarity/flag rules (title from `title` including `title_version`, artist from `artist.name` and `contributors`; no duration term). For free text there is no artist/title to compare, so the first hit whose hard flags are none (unless the text itself contains a version keyword) is the reference, and its artist and `title_short` become the query's artist and title from here on.
2. ISRC bridge: if the reference has an ISRC, `GetRecordingsByIsrcAsync` → score each recording with the reference's duration (`duration` × 1000) → best acceptable one wins. `ResolveAsync` stops here when one is acceptable (so a typical line costs 2 MusicBrainz requests: ISRC lookup + identity).
3. Otherwise `SearchRecordingsAsync(MusicBrainzQuery.RecordingByArtistAndTitle(artist, title), 25)` → score with the reference duration if any → best acceptable one wins.
4. Nothing acceptable in MusicBrainz but a reference hit exists → `ResolvedDeezerOnly` with the Deezer identity (after one more ISRC bridge attempt is **not** needed — it already failed).
5. Nothing → `Unresolved` with a reason ("No match on MusicBrainz or Deezer for 'Nobody - Nothing'") and whatever candidates scored highest (≤ 5) for the review UI.
`SearchAsync` runs steps 1–3 fully (Deezer search, ISRC bridge and MB search), merges MB candidates (deduplicated by MBID, keeping the higher score and `ViaIsrc`), appends Deezer-only candidates for Deezer hits whose ISRC did not map to any MB candidate, sorts by score and cuts to `limit`.

**`MbRecordingId`** → `GetIdentityAsync(mbid)`; 404 → `Unresolved`. **`Isrc`** → `GetRecordingsByIsrcAsync` → the recording with no hard flags and the earliest first-release date (else the first) → identity; none → Deezer `GetTrackByIsrcAsync` → Deezer-only; none → `Unresolved`. **`DeezerTrackId`** → `GetTrackAsync`; its ISRC → MB bridge (score against the Deezer track as reference; acceptable → MB identity with `DeezerId` set) → else Deezer-only; unknown id → `Unresolved`. **`Unsupported`** → `Unsupported` with the reason.

**`GetIdentityAsync` (MusicBrainz):** `GetRecordingAsync` (artist credits, ISRCs) + `GetReleasesForRecordingAsync` (≤ 3 pages). Artists from the credit in order: `Main` until a joinphrase containing `feat`, `ft.`, `featuring` or `with` (case-insensitive) has been passed, `Featured` after it; `ArtistCredit` = `MbArtistCredit.Format`. Flags from title + disambiguation. `OriginalDate` = `first-release-date`. One `ReleaseOption` per release: `Key` = `MbReleaseId` = release id, `MbReleaseGroupId`, `Title`, `AlbumArtist` = formatted release credit, `IsVariousArtists` = any release credit artist id is `89ad4ac3-39f7-470e-963a-56509c546377`, `PrimaryType`/`SecondaryTypes` from the release group, `Status`, `Date`, `ReleaseGroupFirstDate`, `TotalTracks` = sum of media track counts, `TrackNo`/`DiscNo` null (browse media carry no tracks; P1-07 reads them from the chosen release).
**`GetIdentityAsync` (Deezer-only):** `GetTrackAsync` + `GetAlbumAsync(track.album.id)`. Artists from `contributors` (`role` "Main" → Main, else Featured; fall back to `artist`); `ArtistCredit` = main names joined with ", " plus " feat. " + featured names joined with ", " when any; title = `title` (it carries the version); flags from it (+`Explicit` when `explicit_lyrics`); `DurationMs` = `duration` × 1000; `Isrcs` = [isrc]; one `ReleaseOption` from the album: `Key` = a deterministic GUID from MD5 of `"deezer-album:{id}"` (format "D"), no MB ids, `PrimaryType` from `record_type` (album → Album, ep → EP, single → Single, compile → Album with secondary `Compilation`), `Status` "Official", `Date` = `release_date`, `TrackNo` = `track_position`, `DiscNo` = `disk_number`, `TotalTracks` = `nb_tracks`; `CoverUrl` = album `cover_xl`; `OriginalDate` = album `release_date`.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines).
2. `ResolveAsync("Daft Punk - Get Lucky")` → `Resolved`, MBID `833f00e1-781f-4edd-90e4-e52712618862`, duration 369000, artists Daft Punk (Main, 0), Pharrell Williams (Featured, 1), Nile Rodgers (Featured, 2), ≥ 20 release options of which one has `PrimaryType` "Album", no secondary types and title "Random Access Memories"; the Deezer radio edit (hit 1) was **not** the reference (its ISRC `USQX91300809` was never requested); the "Dolby Atmos mix" recording lost; no MB search request was made.
3. `ResolveAsync("Queen - Bohemian Rhapsody")` and `ResolveAsync("queen bohemian rhapsody")` → MBID `b1a9c0e9-d987-4042-ae91-78d6a3267d69`, duration 355106.
4. `ResolveAsync("Queen - Bohemian Rhapsody (Live Aid)")` → not the studio recording: `ResolvedDeezerOnly` with Deezer id 4091936771 and flag `Live` (its ISRC and the MB search are unmapped → 404).
5. `ResolveAsync("b1a9c0e9-d987-4042-ae91-78d6a3267d69")`, the `https://musicbrainz.org/recording/…` URL and `ResolveAsync("GBUM71029604")` → the same MBID; `ResolveAsync("https://www.deezer.com/en/track/3541552051")` → the same MBID with `DeezerId` 3541552051.
6. A synthetic Deezer-only case (inline JSON: one Deezer hit with an ISRC that MB does not know, MB search empty) → `ResolvedDeezerOnly` with a `ReleaseOption` whose key is the deterministic GUID (assert the same GUID for the same album id twice) and `CoverUrl` = the album's `cover_xl`; `"Nobody - Nothing"` (empty Deezer search, empty MB search) → `Unresolved` with a reason naming the input; a Spotify URL → `Unsupported`.
7. `SearchAsync("Daft Punk - Get Lucky", 10)` → first candidate `833f00e1-…` with `ViaIsrc` true; candidates sorted by score descending; no duplicate MBIDs.
8. `TextMatching`: `Similarity("Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger", "Harder Better Faster Stronger")` = 1; `NormalizeArtist("The Beatles")` = `beatles`; `Normalize("Beyoncé & Jay-Z")` = `beyonce and jay z`; `Similarity("Get Lucky", "Get Lucky Tonight")` < 0.85. `LookupInput` covers every kind above including `deezer:track:123`, a hyphenated ISRC and a title containing a second ` - `.
